We have received a Statement of Disagreement submission that requires additional clarification before it may be
accepted and incorporated into the medical record. In order to proceed, please review and complete the items
outlined below and return the documentation to our office. Upon receipt of the completed materials, the
statement will be added to the medical record and included in future disclosures, as applicable.

* The box indicating “I do not want to file a Statement of Disagreement” was marked in error.

0 Ifitis your intent for the submitted Statement of Disagreement to be attached to the medical
record, the appropriate box must be selected, and your initials must be placed adjacent to the
selection.

+ Please ensure that the box indicating “I want to file this Statement of Disagreement” is clearly marked,

Please be advised that, as outlined in the original Request to Amend Protected Health Information, our facility is
not permitted to delete or destroy any information that is already part of the designated medical record. We may
only add statements that clarify or contest existing documentation.
